sections.title: What is this for?
sections.hint: Website images carry the concept-render caption; client mockups go to approval
sections.tip: Website samples go on our site with the caption "Concept render. Production photos are shot for every order." A client mockup shows one customer their idea for approval before they order.

sections.title: Fits we make
sections.tip: Classic has a set-in shoulder and follows the body. Oversized has a dropped shoulder and a wide, boxy body. Full-zip has a metal zip that runs to the neck.

sections.title: Colour
sections.hint: Samples only; customers can choose any colour
sections.tip: These are sample colours for pictures; a customer can have any colour. Pick Custom to type a colour name and its hex code, such as #1F6F78.

sections.title: Fabric weight
sections.hint: Changes how the hoodie hangs in the picture
sections.tip: GSM is how heavy the fleece is. 320 drapes softly, 380 holds gentle structure, and 450 stands away from the body with thick rib and a hood that keeps its shape.

sections.title: Shot type
sections.hint: What kind of picture to make
sections.tip: Packshots and flat lays show the hoodie on its own. On-model shots put it on one of our AI models. A decoration close-up needs a design.

sections.title: Model
sections.hint: Our invented AI models; the same person keeps the same look
sections.tip: Four invented people, described the same way every time so they look consistent across the site. Their images carry the caption "AI model, concept render".

sections.title: Scene
sections.tip: The background and light behind the model. Only on-model shots use a scene; packshots and flat lays keep their own plain background.

sections.title: Decoration
sections.hint: Show a sample design on the hoodie, or keep it plain
sections.tip: Plain shows the hoodie with no branding. A sample design shows what a customer's own artwork could look like; a close-up shot always needs one.

sections.title: Sample design
sections.hint: Invented brands only; each is drawn for dark or light garments
sections.tip: Every brand name here is invented, never a real brand. Each design is drawn for dark or light garments, so one that would not show up on your colour is greyed out.

sections.title: Technique
sections.tip: Screen print lies flat on the fabric. Flat embroidery is stitched thread. 3D puff embroidery is raised stitching that stands up from the fleece.

sections.title: Placement
sections.hint: Where on the garment; limited to what the shot shows
sections.tip: Where the design sits. Sizes are capped at each placement's maximum, and a placement this shot can't show, or whose maximum isn't set yet, is greyed out with the reason.

sections.title: Size (cm)
sections.hint: Width of the design, up to the placement maximum
sections.tip: How wide the design is, in centimetres. The slider stops at the placement's maximum, so a picture never shows a size we can't make.
